name: content-cache.peers
title: Status Content Cache Peers
description: The status item that reports information about the Content Cache service peer caches.

payloadkeys.title: Content cache peers
payloadkeys.content: An array of dictionaries that describes peer Content Caches.

subkeys.title: Peer GUID
subkeys.content: The unique identifier of the peer Content Cache.

subkeys.title: Indicates removal of the entry.
subkeys.content: If `true`, the system removed the peer entry and only this key and the `identifier` key are present in the status item object.

subkeys.title: IP address
subkeys.content: The local IPv4 address of the peer Content Cache.

subkeys.title: Port
subkeys.content: The IP port number the peer Content Cache listens to for requests.

subkeys.title: Friendly
subkeys.content: If `true`, the peer Content Cache is willing to respond to requests from this Content Cache.

subkeys.title: Cache health
subkeys.content: If `true`, the peer Content Cache is able to respond to requests from this Content Cache.

subkeys.title: Version
subkeys.content: The version number of the peer Content Cache software.
